response.original_title: Add@Passenger-How do I add a passenger on a Ponant Cruise
response.overview: To add passengers to a Ponant Cruise, you must call Ponant Cruise directly at ☎️ +1-866-829- 1297(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK] or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online. Additions depend on stateroom capacity,+1-866-829- 1297 ship lifeboat capacity, and current availability ☎️ +1-866-829- 1297(US/Canada) or +44 (204) 586-5316 [UK]. The booking will likely be re-priced at current rates. To add someone to an existing Ponant Cruise booking, you must call Ponant directly at +1-866-829- 1297 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent at +1-866-829- 1297 (US/Canada). This process cannot be completed. Adding a passenger is subject to cabin or room capacity, overall ship capacity, and lifeboat limits.+1-866-829- 1297 It will also trigger a re-price of the cabin or room at the current +1-866-829- 1297 (US/Canada), prevailing fare.
